# 출처: https://zigzag.kr/_openapi/docs/product/product-detail (2026-10-02 내려받아 HTML 태그만 뺀 본문 — 근거 보관용)

상품 상세 정보 | 카카오스타일 오픈 API
본문으로 건너뛰기문서API이 페이지에서상품 상세 정보상품 상세 정보​필요 권한: GET-PRODUCTQuery.product는 상품 정보를 반환합니다.질의문 예제​query GetProduct($id: ID!) {  product(id: $id) {    id    name    brand_id    essentials {      key      name      value    }    sales_status    display_status    parallel_imported    category {      category_id      category_full_name    }    item_list {      id      name      option_type      sales_status      barcode      site_list {        site        country        original_price      }      inventory {        quantity      }    }    order {      quantity {        minimum_per_order        minimum_per_order_type        maximum_per_order        maximum_per_customer      }    }    shipping_days    shipping_type    option_list {      id      name      option_type      format    }    custom_input_option_list {      id      name      option_type    }    trait_list {      id      trait_type    }    tax_type    cancellation_fee_specification_list {      id      base_time      applicable_list      rule_list {        rate        range {          start          end          unit        }      }    }    package_unit {      quantity {        unit        value      }      capacity {        unit        value      }    }  }}호출 예제​$ curl -s http://localhost:9131/1/graphql/GetProduct -H 'Authorization: CEA algorithm=HmacSHA256, access-key=my-access-key, signed-date=2021-03-15, signature=calculated-signature' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' --data '{"query":"query GetProduct($id: ID!) { product(id: $id) { id name brand_id essentials { key name value } sales_status display_status parallel_imported category { category_id category_full_name } site_list { site country discount_price original_price shipping_fee {   fee_type   base_fee   area_fee {   jeju   isolated   }   conditional_amount   return_fee {   total   partial   }   exchange_fee } } item_list { id name option_type item_code external_code sales_status attribute_list { name value } inventory { quantity } site_list { site country original_price } } order { quantity {   minimum_per_order   minimum_per_order_type   maximum_per_order   maximum_per_customer } } shipping_days shipping_type option_list { id name option_type format external_code value_list { id value external_code } } image_list { id origin_url image_type } custom_input_option_list { id name option_type }
